text: Objectives: Students aim to qualify themselves as senior experts who can solve practical problems with means of mathematics and computer technology based on the theory and technique they learn in the field of Mathematics. 1. Performing scientific research in an economics field; 2. Engaging quantitative analysis in finance and economic management fields using economic models; 3. Seeking a career in the field of Education and Administration Management. Object: Four-year Bachelor of Science Degree Main courses: Analytics, Algebra, Geometry, Differential Equation, Probability Theory, Statistics for Engineers, Applied Stochastic Processes, Discrete Mathematics, Mathematical Modeling/Experimentation, Operational Research, Mathematics Models & Applications, Fundamentals of Applied Computer, Economics.
